status: 用户授权改进的开发测试候选；以下技能效果与难度均为回合制改编，非原作官方数值

formula.damage: floor(ATK_or_DEF * coefficient * (120+4*attacker_level)/(120+4*attacker_level+target_DEF) * element_multiplier * (1.5 if already_broken else 1) * (1+min(0.5,damage_amp)) * mitigation); exposed applies x1.15 to its next received packet and consumes once; field mitigation x0.8; cutline source x0.85; rend healing x0.75
formula.rounding: floor each target damage packet; animation hits collapse to one direct packet, separate status packets; all packets use action-start broken snapshot; round_half_up positive stats

rules.break_duration: through end of round r+1; restore at start r+2
rules.elite_boss_recovery_lock: shield floor 1 until first normal enemy action completes after recovery
rules.concerto_buff_expiry: next eligible normal action, no later than end next round
rules.resource_persistence: reset each encounter; HP persists by scenario, no automatic full heal
rules.weakness_visibility: Balance tests know all enemy weaknesses. Recommended initial UI shows all weaknesses in this test package. survey reveal is implemented but discovery gameplay remains outside performance claims.
rules.status_amp: Status packets do not inherit field/ordinary outro damage amp; cutline and special status outro add 0.25 each, capped together at +0.50.
rules.phase_queue: At phase announcement, replace next ordinary boss action with wingpulse; never insert a new action. Pending break delays that action.
rules.recovery_policy: No forced damage/enrage clock; long unfinished simulations are inconclusive, never forced defeat.
rules.pry: Always exactly one shield point per target; tune can add damage but never extra shield reduction to pry.
rules.battlefield_orientation: Enemies on screen left face right; allies on screen right face left. Screen orientation is not anatomical left/right; do not mirror asymmetrical assets.
rules.outro_channels: Take strongest direct amp and strongest liberation-extra independently; the two count toward direct +50% cap with field. Status-outro has a separate one-use token until end of grant round+2 and is consumed by the next qualifying status damage from its recipient, including a previously placed marker; no direct attack consumes that token. Intro gain stays <=20 per recipient per round. Solo self-concerto grants half direct amp only; no intro or special channel.
rules.concerto_auto: Manual by default, even for single-step autoAction. Explicit auto_concerto option can be requested by automatic simulation only.
rules.tune_teamwork: A different ally hitting a marked weakness consumes one tune mark: +1 break (except universal pry), owner 0.5 status packet, and triggering actor primary +10 once per normal action. Derived packet grants no resources.
rules.field: Current and next round: direct damage +15%, damage received x0.8. No free actions, healing or concerto.
rules.enemy_charge: A charge uses one ordinary enemy action and publishes its committed next skill/targets. Heavy attack consumes the next ordinary action. Break cancels charge and skips only its pending heavy; no extra actions. Phase transition does not advance normal pattern.
rules.items: Each test battle owns an isolated 2 repair / 1 cleanse inventory. No currency, drops, permanent inventory, or revival. Using an item consumes one normal action and gives no concerto.
rules.debuffs: Rend: healing received x0.75 through grant round+1. Exposed: next incoming damage +15%, consumed once; guard still halves resulting damage. Cleanse removes both.
rules.taunt_consumption: Only a damaging single-target enemy action consumes taunt; AOE cannot redirect or consume it, but the normal expiry still applies.
rules.ko_retreat_buffs: KO/retreat clears own statuses, all personal resources, form and own tune/taunt markers. Existing recipient-owned outro/barrier and timed cutline/fusion/field keep their normal expiry; they do not revive their source or trigger extra actions.

crownless.phase_rule: A charge uses one ordinary enemy action and publishes its committed next skill/targets. Heavy attack consumes the next ordinary action. Break cancels charge and skips only its pending heavy; no extra actions. Phase transition does not advance normal pattern. Phase 2 attack multiplier x1.2; wingpulse replaces one normal slot without advancing the rotation; an already-committed charge resolves first.

growth.status: 推荐；此批战斗基线已启用完整技能，无声骸/传统装备选择预设
growth.baseline_weapon: Every character except Mornye includes ATK40 at weapon level20; Mornye includes DEF30. Final stat=round((stat20-W20)*(0.6+0.02*L)+W20*(0.6+0.02*weapon_level)); round only once after summing. Simulation matched-level uses same-level standardized weapon.

mastery.baseline: per skill 3 or 4, not uniformly 0; listed coefficient already includes this reference mastery
mastery.progress: effective use in a meaningful encounter +1 XP per skill, at most once per encounter; story-confirmed training +5 per unique session; meaningful stage completion with that skill +3 once per encounter; thresholds total 0/10/30/60/100/150. Repeated trivial fights alone do not authorize mastery promotion; training or significant experience flag also required. New learned skills may start at 0; no automatic signature-skill amnesia.

growth.optional_weapon_upgrade_limit: Current branch supports weapon stat only. Grade/affixes/equipment system unresolved; any future extra combat-stat contribution beyond standardized weapon must stay within +15% primary stat until separately retested.
growth.new_skills: No untested new skill is promised. Story-unlock schedule and experience economy are outside this balance batch; baseline20 roster is treated as fully learned. Level1/10/40/60 tests are matched-level arithmetic stress tests with same unlocked kit, not validated progression pacing.

easy.name: 轻松

challenge.description: 更高韧性与伤害；车刃镰和头目首回合蓄力，坚岩斗士压缩轮转；未锁定单体攻击优先生命比例最低者。
